findings.label: Layout sets wrong intendedPath
findings.detail: handleOpenRequestRentalModal in Layout.tsx hardcodes auth.setIntendedPath('/marketplace') instead of `/item/${listing.id}`. After sign-up, the user is returned to the marketplace grid rather than the item page, so the auto-open effect in ItemDetailPage never triggers. Fix: set intendedPath to `/item/${listing.id}` in the guard branch.

findings.label: pendingItemId not persisted across page reload
findings.detail: pendingItemId lives in React context only. A browser refresh between the redirect and completing sign-up clears it silently. On sign-up success intendedPath is also null, so the user is sent to /dashboard with no pending item and no modal. Fix: write pendingItemId to sessionStorage on set and hydrate it on AuthContext init.

findings.label: useEffect missing dependencies
findings.detail: ItemDetailPage's useEffect array is [auth.isAuthenticated, auth.pendingItemId] but the effect body references listing and onOpenRequestRentalModal, both captured as stale closures. Fix: include all referenced identifiers in the dependency array, or refactor to read pendingItemId outside the effect and use a ref guard.

findings.label: renterPhone minimum-length not enforced in modal
findings.detail: validateForm in RequestRentalModal only checks !fields.renterPhone.trim(). A single non-whitespace character passes validation. SignUpPage enforces >= 9 chars; these two validators are inconsistent. Fix: add the same >= 9 chars check to the modal's validateForm.

findings.label: Login flow produces AuthUser without phone
findings.detail: AuthContext.login builds an AuthUser from the email address and never sets phone. Users who arrive via /signin get an empty renterPhone pre-fill in the modal. Combined with the weak modal validation, they can submit a rental request with an effectively empty phone number. Fix: either require phone at sign-in time when a pendingItemId is active, or add a minimum-length check in the modal that surfaces a clear error for the empty pre-fill case.
